method: Read the persisted final 300 poems and aligned pinyin arrays. Match the literal Han phrase in each full poem; record actual occurrence positions, contexts and stored syllables. Compare every found occurrence with the 85 manually recorded expected phrases. This is neither isolated pronounce() testing nor listening to audio. Phrases may span display lines; indices are zero based Han-character indices after punctuation removal.
